title: 第12章 祖凤宫骆天妃第13章 你不配
slug: 吞噬古帝第6589章炼化雷城
lines: 在苏辰看来，作为男人就应该大度点，哪怕此事自己是被动的。
好在自己也不算吃亏，此女拥有著惊世骇俗的容顏，要是个丑八怪，那真是坑爹了。
“负责？”
女子被此话逗笑了。
一个小小的筑基境，竟然说要对她负责，如何负责？怎么负责？
脸色瞬间一冷，苏辰能够从女子眼里看出深深的轻蔑，他明白对方的意思，无非是看自己修为低下而已。
“今日之事，就当做是个意外，你忘记即可。”
苏辰却是笑著说道：“你认为是个意外，而我苏辰却不是隨便之人，现在的我的確没有资格负责，不过日后我会告诉天下人，你是我苏辰的女人。”
女子根本不相信。
点点头，女子笑著说道：“那我期待那一天。”
在她看来，每个人都会说，只是想要做到却是另外一回事。
筑基境想要负责，本身就是个笑话。
看著转身准备离去的女子，苏辰问道：“你叫什么名字？”
“祖凤宫，骆天妃。”
看著已经消失的身影，苏辰眼神里写满了坚定，到现在都有些懵逼，没有想到自己的第一次，会在这里失去，並且还是和一个陌生女人。
祖凤宫？
从未听说过，东荒有这么一个宗门。
不过苏辰也很清楚，东荒很大，宗门更是无数，单单是皇朝就足足有著成千上万，自己不知道祖凤宫也实属正常。
经过一夜的折腾，苏辰没有继续逗留，立刻以最快的速度离去。
因为骆天妃的屠杀，使得整个天罚森林深处的妖兽陨落殆尽，所以苏辰没有遇到任何阻碍，便顺利穿过天罚森林。
有惊无险。
对於筑基境武者来说，天罚森林的確是个很危险的地方，稍有不慎就会陨落此处。
“小子，等等。”
刚刚离开天罚森林的苏辰，便被两个男子拦截下来，全部都是虚丹境，其中一人更是只有一米四，一脸的阴险狡诈。
“有事？”
“你从天罚森林能够活著出来，相信你身上一定有不少好东西，我两也不会杀你，只要你乖乖交出你的空间戒指。”
杀人越货，很是正常的事情。
根本未將青年放在眼里，身为虚丹境武者，不要说联手，哪怕是其中一人，都可以轻鬆做到抹杀。
没有任何的废话，想要抢夺自己的空间戒指，也要看看是否有那个本事。
滚石拳，苏家武阁蕴藏武技之一。
苏辰施展起来，犹如巨石从悬崖翻滚咆哮，一拳接著一拳，拳劲虎虎生风，直接朝著两人狠狠轰击而来。
“找死！”
content_en:
In Su Chen's view, as a man, he should be more generous, even if he is passive in this matter.
Fortunately, I am not at a disadvantage. This girl has a shocking appearance. If she is ugly, she will be really cheating.
"Responsible?"
The woman was amused by this statement.
A small person in the Foundation Establishment Realm actually said he was responsible for her. How could he be responsible? How to be responsible?
His face turned cold for a moment, and Su Chen could see the deep contempt in the woman's eyes. He understood what the other party meant, and it was just that he was looking at his low cultivation level.
"Just treat what happened today as an accident and forget about it."
Su Chen said with a smile: "You think it is an accident, but I, Su Chen, am not a casual person. I am indeed not qualified to take responsibility now, but in the future I will tell the world that you are my Su Chen's woman."
The woman didn't believe it at all.
Nodding, the woman smiled and said, "Then I look forward to that day."
In her opinion, just wanting to do it, everyone would say, was something else.
Wanting to be responsible in the Foundation Establishment Realm is a joke in itself.
Looking at the woman who turned around and was about to leave, Su Chen asked, "What's your name?"
"Zufeng Palace, Luo Tianfei."
Looking at the disappeared figure, Su Chen's eyes were full of determination. He was still a little confused until now. He never thought that his first time would be lost here, and it would be with a strange woman.
Zufeng Palace?
I have never heard of such a sect in the Eastern Wasteland.
However, Su Chen also knew very well that Donghuang was very big, with countless sects, and the dynasty alone had thousands of them, so it was normal for him not to know Zufeng Palace.
After a night of tossing, Su Chen did not stay any longer and left immediately as quickly as possible.
Because Luo Tianfei's massacre wiped out all the monsters in the depths of the Heavenly Punishment Forest, Su Chen successfully passed through the Heavenly Punishment Forest without encountering any obstacles.
No near misses.
For Foundation Establishment level warriors, the Heavenly Punishment Forest is indeed a very dangerous place, and they will fall here if they are not careful.
"Boy, wait."
Su Chen, who had just left the Heavenly Punishment Forest, was intercepted by two men, both of whom were in the Void Core realm. One of them was only 1.4 meters tall, with a sinister and cunning look on his face.
"Is something wrong?"
"You can come out of the Forest of Punishment alive. I believe you must have a lot of good things in your body. We will not kill you, as long as you obediently hand over your space ring."
Killing people and stealing goods is a normal thing.
He didn't take the young man seriously at all. As a Void Core Realm warrior, not to mention joining forces, even one of them could be easily obliterated.
There is no nonsense. If you want to snatch your own space ring, you have to see if you have the ability.
Rolling Stone Fist, one of the martial arts in the Su Family Martial Arts Pavilion.
When Su Chen used it, it was like a boulder rolling down a cliff and roaring, punching one after another, with powerful punches and strong winds, directly hitting the two of them fiercely.
"court death!"
